facts.text: US data week of 12-16 Oct 2026: September CPI on Wed 14 Oct; PPI, retail sales and Philadelphia Fed index on Thu 15 Oct; import prices and industrial production on Fri 16 Oct.
facts.verification: single-aggregator; confirm on BLS release schedule before publishing

facts.text: The Fed raised rates by 25 bp at its late-September meeting to 3.75-4.00%, reported as its first hike in three years. Next FOMC decision listed for 28 Oct.
Headline inflation expected to stay elevated on higher gasoline prices (Kiplinger). Aggregator lists a 3.6% y/y headline forecast; figures vary by provider.

interpretations.text: CPI on 14 Oct is the week's main volatility catalyst for XAUUSD and USD pairs because it feeds directly into rate-hike expectations. This is FOXREX framing, not a forecast of direction.
